title: Workflow invocation cancel: Django proxy and CDP route must agree on the id format and the cap
answers: where is workflow run cancellation handled
raising the max invocation ids for cancel
invocation_ids vs all selector in hog flow cancel
body:
Cancel flows through the Django workflows API, which proxies to the CDP route `POST /api/projects/:team/hog_flows/:flow/invocations/cancel` in nodejs/src/cdp/cdp-api.ts:CdpApi. That route calls `cancelJobs` filtered on (team_id, function_id).
Invariant: the Django cancel serializer and the CDP zod schema must accept the same id set. Both read the same env-driven max-ids cap, so raising the env var lifts both limits together. If the CDP route rejects an id that Django accepted, the route returns a 400 and Django surfaces it to the user as a 500.
The accepted id format must match too. Both sides must accept UUIDTs: Django's UUIDField already does, and CDP uses `UUID.validateString(id, false)`.
Testing: the cancel tests in nodejs/src/cdp/cdp-api.serial.test.ts mostly use `all: true`. The `invocation_ids` path needs its own cases. Run them with `jest --config jest.serial.config.js --testPathPatterns=cdp-api.serial -t cancel`. The Django side is products/workflows/backend/api/test/test_hog_flow_cancel.py, which patches the CDP proxy.
applies: Changes to hog flow / workflow invocation cancellation in Django or the CDP API
